تزدجرون (form VIII)
# تَزْدَجِرُونَ (tazdajirūna) /taz.da.d͡ʒi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# تُزْدَجَرُونَ (tuzdajarūna) /tuz.da.d͡ʒa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
